claims.claim_text: Supports Modbus RTU standard read function codes FC01, FC03, and FC04
claims.notes: Section 'Main workflow' documents FC01-FC04 quick scan support

claims.claim_text: Provides COM port parameter configuration including baudrate, parity, stop bits and address scan range 1-247
claims.notes: Port panel parameters and address bounding documented in User Manual

claims.claim_text: Device identity identification is strictly governed by reviewed JSON profiles, otherwise returns NOT_AVAILABLE
claims.notes: User Manual explicitly states application never fabricates SN values

claims.claim_text: Manual write functions FC06 and FC16 are disabled by default in candidate scan mode for safety
claims.notes: Section 'Writes' specifies default disabled state until explicit confirmation

claims.claim_text: Generates diagnostic reports in HTML and PDF formats from unified session data model
claims.notes: Export features and data model verified in User Manual

claims.claim_text: Protocol engine, CRC calculator, frame parser and offscreen GUI pass 40 unit and integration tests
claims.notes: 40/40 passed pytest run in isolated sandbox execution

claims.claim_text: Release deliverables comprise standalone Windows installer executable and portable standalone ZIP package
claims.notes: Local installer smoke and portable test outcomes documented

claims.claim_text: Software distributed under Jovi commercial evaluation license terms
claims.notes: License agreement specifies terms and rights reservation

claims.notes: Notices file inventories bundled third-party dependencies

claims.notes: Compatibility matrix clarifies hardware and OS boundaries
